heading: INT. ROLLER RINK - DJ BOOTH - NIGHT

units.text: INT. ROLLER RINK - DJ BOOTH - NIGHT
Disco ball turning, colored lights sliding across empty hardwood.
The rink is closed; the booth is a cluttered box of turntables and cables.
JUNE (16, braids, rink-staff polo shirt) sits at the mixer wearing headphones around her neck.
TEO (17, skinny, backpack on both shoulders) leans in the doorway, holding a paper bag.
You said ten o'clock.
units.name: TEO

units.text: It's ten-oh-four.
units.name: JUNE

units.text: I ran here.
units.name: TEO

units.text: You walked. I watched you from the window.
units.name: JUNE

units.text: Teo grins and hands her the bag.
June pulls out a cassette tape in a cracked case.
Is this it?
units.name: JUNE

units.text: My dad's mix. Nineteen eighty-four. He made it for my mom.
units.name: TEO

units.text: And you want me to play it on the rink system.
units.name: JUNE

units.text: Just once. Before they tear the place down.
units.name: TEO

units.text: June looks out at the empty floor, then back at the tape.
A PHONE on the desk buzzes.
She answers it, thumbing the speaker.
Junebug, where are you? Mom's been calling the house for an hour.
units.name: RAQUEL

units.text: Work, Raquel. I told you.
units.name: JUNE

units.text: It's a school night. Come home.
units.name: RAQUEL

units.text: Five more minutes.
units.name: JUNE

units.text: Who's there with you?
units.name: RAQUEL

units.text: June clamps her hand over the phone.
Teo shakes his head, mouthing, no. June hangs up.
She'll tell Mom.
units.name: JUNE

units.text: Then play it fast.
units.name: TEO

units.text: June slides the tape into the deck.
A fat bassline wobbles out, warped by age.
They stand there, listening to a dead man's song fill the hall.
That's him humming.
units.name: TEO

units.text: That's the best part.
units.name: JUNE

units.text: The booth light snaps on.
MR. LINDQVIST (60s, bathrobe over his work clothes, a flashlight) fills the doorway.
Who authorized this?
units.name: LINDQVIST

units.text: I did!
units.name: JUNE

units.text: I did!
units.name: TEO

units.text: It was my idea, sir!
units.name: ^JUNE

units.text: She had nothing to do with it!
units.name: ^TEO

units.text: Turn it off.
units.name: LINDQVIST

units.text: June reaches for the stop button.
Lindqvist's hand clamps on hers.
No. Not off. Turn it up.
units.name: LINDQVIST

units.text: He sets his flashlight down and sits heavily on a stool.
The bassline swells.
Outside the booth, the disco ball keeps turning.
